metric_protocol.name: uno-selected-reference-v1
metric_protocol.reference_policy: exact manifest image_path; one reference per generated image
metric_protocol.clip_preprocess: RGB; bicubic resize shorter edge 224; center crop 224; CLIP normalization
metric_protocol.dino_preprocess: RGB; bicubic resize shorter edge 256; center crop 224; ImageNet normalization
metric_protocol.clip_t: max(0, cosine(generated, original target_prompt)); weight=1; no prefix; truncate=True
metric_protocol.image_metrics: cosine(generated, selected reference); no clipping; no logit scale
metric_protocol.aggregation: per benchmark, condition and class: reference macro and case micro; class macro separately
metric_protocol.category_policy: DreamBench explicit animal/object map; DreamBench++ reference collection category
